author: DaiqingChen
body:
*  **Annotation pipeline** 
Refine the basement membrane genes, start with the matrisome genes, and add label of whether showed up in (1) MSigDB [basement membrane gene list](https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb/human/geneset/NABA_BASEMENT_MEMBRANES.html) (2) GO basement membrane (GO:0005604) (3) basement membrane base, human and/or mouse, both antibody or endogenous tag evidence [bmBase](https://bmbasedb.manchester.ac.uk/search/?q=&s=1&pc_none=on&pc=14&pc=4&pc=3&pc=2&pc=5&pc=13&pc=12&pc=1&pc=11&pc=6).

* **As a result, there are**:
  41 is_active in gene products,
  24 located_in gene products.

* **The list of all basement membrane related genes**:
[251114_basement membrane gene list_DC.xlsx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23556245/251114_basement.membrane.gene.list_DC.xlsx)




----------------------------------- update 251121 ---------------------------------
 
Updated the list with evidence type (review/experiment) and added reference for all genes: 
[251121_basement membrane gene list_DC.xlsx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23684730/251121_basement.membrane.gene.list_DC.xlsx)

updated some Uniport ID
[251211_basement membrane gene list_DC.xlsx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24113493/251211_basement.membrane.gene.list_DC.xlsx)

------------------------ update 260106 -------------
Need to remove COL13A1, COL17A1 from basement membrane, they are plasma membrane collagen.

author: DaiqingChen
body:
> Hi [@DaiqingChen](https://github.com/DaiqingChen)
> 
> From the excel spreadsheet, only 22 genes have a reference. Should I annotate those ?
> 
> Also, do you know if the evidence is experimental in these papers? Or are they reviews?
> 
> Thanks, Pascale

Hi Pascale,
    For those genes don't have reference, they are either already annotated as a gene product of the GO:0005604 basement membrane term, or the reference is PMID: 22159717, from the [MsigDB pathway](https://www.gsea-msigdb.org/gsea/msigdb/human/geneset/NABA_BASEMENT_MEMBRANES.html.).

I updated the excel sheet with the evidence type and reference for all genes [251121_basement membrane gene list_DC.xlsx](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23684730/251121_basement.membrane.gene.list_DC.xlsx)
